name: Surin
intro: Surin is a small, upmarket beach between Kamala and Bang Tao, known for its luxury resorts and the exclusive coastal strip often called "Millionaire's Mile". Property here is limited and generally high-end.
overview: Surin is a small, upmarket beach area between Kamala and Bang Tao on Phuket's west coast. Projects in our catalogue here are condominiums close to Surin Beach, with Bang Tao and the Laguna area a few minutes north.
suitableFor: Holidaymakers who want a smaller, upscale beach
highlights: Compact, attractive beach with rocky headlands
Luxury resorts and villas along the coast
Close to Bang Tao, Laguna and Kamala

lifestyle: Surin offers beach restaurants, upscale resorts and easy access to the shops and restaurants of Bang Tao and Laguna. It is quiet in the evenings.
beaches: Surin Beach is a short, steep beach that is beautiful in the dry season but can have strong waves and currents from about May to October; surfers use it in the monsoon season.
rentalMarket: Surin's rental market is small and upmarket, aimed at guests who value a quieter, more exclusive beach. Demand is seasonal and depends on quality and management.

rentalDetails.title: Short-term holiday rentals
rentalDetails.text: High-end condos and villas let to couples and families who want a smaller beach; the dry season is the main period.

rentalDetails.title: Advantages and limitations
rentalDetails.text: Advantage: scarce supply and an upmarket reputation. Limitations: high prices, a small market and seasonality.

investment: Surin is a lifestyle-led luxury location. Buyers usually prioritise personal use and long-term value of a scarce location over high rental income.

investmentDetails.title: Typical investor profiles
investmentDetails.text: Luxury second-home owners and buyers of premium condos.

investmentDetails.title: Risks to consider
investmentDetails.text: A small buyer and tenant pool at the top end of the market; resale can take time.

investmentDetails.title: Ownership costs
investmentDetails.text: Higher common fees in premium buildings, villa maintenance, management and insurance.

faq.question: Is Surin Beach good for swimming?
faq.answer: From about November to April Surin is good for swimming; in the monsoon months the beach is steep and the waves can be dangerous, so check the flags.

faq.question: What is "Millionaire's Mile" in Phuket?
faq.answer: It is the stretch of coast between Kamala and Surin known for exclusive private villas.

faq.question: How far is Surin from the airport?
faq.answer: Our project data gives about 23 km to Phuket International Airport, usually around 30 to 40 minutes by car.

faq.question: Is Surin close to Bang Tao and Laguna?
faq.answer: Yes, Bang Tao and the Laguna Phuket area are just north of Surin, a few minutes by car.

faq.question: Are there many new projects in Surin?
faq.answer: Supply is limited compared with Bang Tao or Cherng Talay; our catalogue lists only a small number of projects here.
